d:
On huge public demand, and as promised, I’m thrilled to present this cherished Himachali folk bhajan dedicated to Lord Shiva: Shiv Kailash
This soulful bhajan from Himachal Pradesh is a beautiful ode to Lord Shiva, the ruler of the majestic Dhauladhar mountain range and the eternal resident of Mount Kailash. The opening lines, “Shiv Kailasho ke waasi, Dhaulidharo ke raja, Shankar sankat harna!” are a heartfelt prayer to seek Shiva’s blessings to remove all obstacles and negativity from our lives.
